question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.
sql:
WITH valid_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year 
    FROM Movie 
    WHERE year GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
),
valid_movies AS (
    SELECT year 
    FROM Movie 
    WHERE year GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
),
period_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        vy.year as start_year,
        COUNT(m.year) as film_count
    FROM valid_years vy
    LEFT JOIN valid_movies m ON CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) >= CAST(vy.year AS INTEGER) 
        AND CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) <= CAST(vy.year AS INTEGER) + 9
    GROUP BY vy.year
)
SELECT start_year, film_count
FROM (
    SELECT start_year, film_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY film_count DESC) as rn
    FROM period_counts
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1
